newsitem.title: USA: CBOT nearby rice ends sharply higher on USDA data.
newsitem.headline: CBOT nearby rice ends sharply higher on USDA data.

text.p: CBOT nearby rice futures ended sharply higher for the second straight day after USDA cut its U.S. ending stocks projection in Wednesday's supply and demand report, traders said.

USDA on Wednesday cut its U.S. ending rice stocks forecast to 24.3 million cwt from 25.3 million cwt in the January report. Export estimates were increased to 75.0 million cwt from 74.0 million cwt in the previous report.
Floor traders said commercial cash-related buying supported the market and prompted speculation that export business was in the works. Buy stops were hit on the close, they said.
"They reduced the stocks number and evidentally Colombia is buying because there was a lot of trade pricing," a trader said.

Traders also cited news the Philippines plan to import up to 650,000 tonnes of rice before July. A Philippine Agriculture Department official told Reuters domestic production falls in the third quarter and the country will need to augment supplies.
Rice closed 29 to 10 cents per cwt higher with March up 29 at $12.155 per cwt.
